subject: general
question:
Seven persons L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting in a row facing north.

Only two are sitting to the right of N. Only two are sitting between N and R. Only two are sitting between L and Q. Q is sitting to the immediate left of N. O is sitting to the immediate right of P.

Who is sitting third from the left in the row?
solution:
GIven :Seven persons L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row facing north.

 
• Only two are sitting to the right of N.
 
• Only two are sitting between N and R.
 
• Q is sitting to the immediate left of N.
 
• Only two are sitting between L and Q.
 
• O is sitting to the immediate right of P.

**
The final arrangement is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1d98da6d0fbe82a4ae2dd4002d49213e83a35a0cf303221a4377f8604a6cfb2.png] 

M is sitting third from left in the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"**
